polityNote: Socialist Republic of Vietnam from 2 Jul 1976. Atoms: the districts of geoBoundaries VNM ADM2 (OCHA ROAP / Government of Viet Nam; a c. 2013–2019 layout: Kỳ Sơn still a district of Hòa Bình, Phục Hòa and Quảng Uyên still separate, Ia H'Drai not yet cut from Sa Thầy), assigned to provinces from Wikipedia's district list and the atoms' shared boundaries. A province is a union of whole districts; the change list (vi.wikipedia and the National Assembly resolutions themselves) shows every line drawn here unchanged over its span, except where named in unresolved. Unlegislated provincial boundary disputes (27 points in 2008 per the Ministry of Home Affairs, several settled 2017–2020 by government resolution) are not treated as changes; the published lines are taken as the legal lines. The Hoàng Sa (Paracel) and Trường Sa (Spratly) district atoms are sea envelopes over contested islands and are not drawn. Replaces the earlier Natural Earth dossier (1997–2019), whose Hanoi, Vĩnh Phúc, Hòa Bình, Phú Thọ, Lai Châu, Điện Biên and Lào Cai atoms followed no real layout. ① Areas (union of atoms / stated in the 2008 resolutions): Hanoi 3,366/3,344.70 km² = 1.006; Vĩnh Phúc 1,240/1,231.76 = 1.007; Hòa Bình 4,592/4,596.35 = 0.999; Phú Thọ 3,547/3,532.95 = 1.004; Bình Phước 6,891/6,882.16 = 1.001; Đồng Nai 5,926/5,905.23 = 1.004; against the Statoids mid-1993 table: Hanoi 930/921 = 1.010, Hà Bắc 4,725/4,614 = 1.024, Hải Hưng 2,607/2,551 = 1.022, Nam Hà 2,525/2,492 = 1.013, Minh Hải 7,780/7,689 = 1.012, Bắc Thái 6,587/6,503 = 1.013, Cao Bằng 8,562/8,445 = 1.014, Cần Thơ 3,077/2,951 = 1.043, Đắk Lắk 19,627/19,800 = 0.991, Lai Châu 16,971/17,131 = 0.991, Lào Cai 8,086/8,050 = 1.004; Quảng Nam–Đà Nẵng 11,596 against 11,348 in the 1996 resolution (QN 10,406.34 + ĐN 942.46) = 1.022. Before 1994 the 38 provinces of 1976 are unions of today's provinces where the change list moves only whole districts; where a resolution moved single communes (Hanoi 1978, Côn Đảo 1977/1979, Lâm Đồng 1981, Phú Yên/Khánh Hòa 1993) the provinces on both sides are withheld until the line is an atom line, and the windows between a resolution and the day its provinces began operating are not assigned. ① 1976–1991 unions against the areas stated in the 12 Aug 1991 resolution: Nghệ Tĩnh 22,562/22,502 km² = 1.003; Hà Tuyên 13,853/13,631 = 1.016; Gia Lai–Kon Tum 25,289/25,000 = 1.012; Hoàng Liên Sơn 14,993/14,125 = 1.061 (the resolution rounds Lào Cai to 7,500 km²; Statoids gives 8,050 for Lào Cai with Than Uyên in 1993, against 8,085 here).
